2c295b08ef9cae4221e7.headline: UMkhandlu waseGoli uhlehlisele uLwesihlanu ukuvota kukameya ngenxa yezingxoxo zobumbano
2c295b08ef9cae4221e7.dek: Umholi we-ActionSA uHerman Mashaba usesikhundleni sokuba yimeya, kanti i-DA iphikisile ukuhlala komkhandlu njengoba izingxoxo zisaqhubeka.
2c295b08ef9cae4221e7.why: Amakhansela aseGoli kumele manje axazulule ubumbano akhethe imeya nezinye izikhulu emhlanganweni wangoLwesihlanu.
paragraphs: Umhlangano wokuqala womkhandlu waseGoli weminyaka ka-2026–2031 usususiwe ngoMsombuluko wayiswa ngoLwesihlanu njengoba izingxoxo zobumbano zisaqhubeka, ngokusho kweDaily Maverick. Umholi we-ActionSA uHerman Mashaba kuthiwa usesikhundleni sokuba yimeya emva kokuthi amaqembu efike ezinhlelweni emikhandlwini eminingi.

Akukho qembu eliwine ngobuningi eGoli. I-Democratic Alliance (DA) ithole ama-34.84% amavoti, okuyisibalo esiphakeme kunazo zonke, kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi ahlale kuphikiso. Lo muzi wawuhlele umhlangano wokuqala womkhandlu ngo-13:00 ngoMsombuluko eConnie Bapela Council Chambers ukufungisa amakhansela nokukhetha usosha nezinye izikhulu.

I-DA ithumelele umphathi wedolobha uFloyd Brink incwadi yommeli ecela ukuba kuhlehliswe, ithi izingxoxo zisenzeka, kubika iTimesLIVE. Unobhala we-ANC eGreater Johannesburg uSasabona Manganye uthe amaqembu angu-18 emkhandlwini avumile ukusebenza ne-ANC, kanti i-DA izwakalise ukungajabuli kwayo.

b74020520bfb310f43e2.headline: Ikhomishini inika uMnyango weMfundo izinsuku ezingu-60 ukuba ulungise izinkinga ezikoleni
b74020520bfb310f43e2.dek: Ikhomishini ikhulume ngokuminyana kwabafundi emakilasini, izakhiwo ezingaphepheni nokungabi bikho kwezindlu zangasese.
b74020520bfb310f43e2.why: Abafundi abasemakilasini agcwele kakhulu kanye nalezo zikole ezingenazo izindlu zangasese ezisebenzayo kuzomele balinde uMnyango, owunikwe izinsuku ezingu-60 ukuthi uphendule.
paragraphs: IKhomishini Yamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika inike uMnyango wezMfundo Eyisisekelo izinsuku ezingu-60 ukuthi uphendule ngezinkinga ezingapheli zikahulumeni ezikoleni, yase isho ukuthi iz Thatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma izincomo zayo zingalandelwa. Lokhu kuvela Umbikweni Wokuhlolwa Kwezimo Zezikole ka-2026 weHuman Sciences Research Council owakhishwa ngoMsombuluko, mhla ziyi-23 kuNovemba.

Lo mbiko uqophe abafundi abayi-101 ekilasini likaGrade 8 nabayi-99 likaGrade 10 esikoleni i-Adolf Mhinga Senior Secondary School eLimpopo. Uphinde wathola ukuthi kunezifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye ezinekinga yokushoda kwamafaisha, kanti abahloli babone abafundi abathathu babelana ngedeski elilodwa kwezinye izikole KwaZulu-Natal naseKapa Lakeni.
Ikhomishini icele ukuthi kube nohlelo lwezimali lokwakha amakilasi engeziwe nokuthenga amafaisha. UMnyango ubufake imibiko ePhalamende ngezinkinga zengqalasizinda yezikole ekuqaleni kuka-2026.

6f2b2d170043e756d820.headline: Ufakazi ubehlwitha iphoyisa laseGoli elimisiwe ngokusiza iqembu likaMolefe
6f2b2d170043e756d820.dek: KwiKhomishini kaMadlanga, iphoyisa lithe imiyalezo ikhombisa ukuthi uJohannes Mokgatle ubenezandla okwedlula ukuba umunyu.
6f2b2d170043e756d820.why: Abaphathi bamaphoyisa aseGoli nabaphenyisi kumele babhekane nezinsolo zokuthi iphoyisa lisebenzise amandla alo ukuze lizuze nabasolwa.
paragraphs: Iphoyisa le-SAPS lophando ePitoli lithe kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga ngoMsombuluko ukuthi uJohannes Mokgatle oyiphoyisa elimisiwe laseMetro yaseGoli, wayengaphezulu komunyu nje kuphela kumuntu osolwa ngokubulala uKatiso "KT" Molefe nabangane bakhe. Ufakazi C uthe imiyalezo ye-WhatsApp ikhombisa ukuthi uMokgatle wayeyingxenye yeqembu labo futhi kungenzeka waba ingxenye yemisebenzi yabo.

Le miyalezo ethathwe kwiphoni kaMokgatle ngoFebruwari 2025, ichaza leli qembu ngokuthi "umndeni" noma "ubuzalwane", kufakaza uFakazi C. Uthe le miyalezo ikhombisa ukuthi uMokgatle wayesondelene kakhulu noMolefe nabanye abasolwa ngokubulala unjiniyela u-Armand Swart. UMolefe ucalwa kanye noMusa Kekena, Tiego Floyd Mabusela kanye nowayelijaji lasekhaya uMichael Pule Tau.

UFakazi C uphinde wacashela uMokgatle ngokusebenzisa isikhundla sakhe samaphoyisa nokuthola ulwazi oluyimfihlo ukuze asize uMolefe nabangane bakhe. Uthe isimo sasingaphansi kukaTau, owayebika kuMolefe, kanti uMolefe wayebonakala ebikela usaziwayo wamataxi ongasekhona uJotham "King Mswazi" Msibi.

d803a3611c8ccff9200c.headline: Abosibhakabhaka baxwayisa izifundazwe ezintathu ngezulu elibi
d803a3611c8ccff9200c.dek: Isexwayiso seLevel 4 besiqhubeka kuze kube u-23:59 ngoMsombuluko, kuneziphepho zemvula enkulu, isichotho nemimoya enamandla eGauteng, Limpopo naseMpumalanga.
d803a3611c8ccff9200c.why: Abahlali ezindaweni eziphansi nabashayeli babhekene nengozi yezikhukhula nokuphepha emigwaqeni ngaphambi kokuba isexwayiso siphele ngoMsombuluko.
paragraphs: Abosibhakabhaka baseNingizimu Afrika bakhiphe isexwayiso seYellow Level 4 sezulu esibi eGauteng, Limpopo naseMpumalanga ngoMsombuluko, mhla ziyi-23 kuNovemba. Siqale ngo-13:00 saze saba semthethweni kuze kube u-23:59.

Isibhakabhaka sixwayise ngokuthi imvula eningi, isichotho nemimoya enamandla kungadala izikhukhula ezindaweni eziphansi, emijondolweni nasemigwaqeni, futhi kulimaze nezakhiwo. Uthe iziphepho kulindeleke ukuthi zibe seNingizimu neNkabankulu yeGauteng kanye naseMpumalanga eningizimu-ntshonalanga, kanti isexwayiso besihlanganisa neLimpopo.

Okhulumela uMnyango Wezinhlekelele eGoli, uRobert Mulaudzi, unxuse abahlali ukuthi bagweme imigwaqo egcwele amanzi, amabhuloho aphansi, imifula namadamu. Esinye isexwayiso seLevel 4 sikhishiwe ngezindawo zaseKwaZulu-Natal, eMpumalanga eningizimu, eFreistata esempumalanga naseNtshonalanga Koloni ngoLwesibili, mhla ziyi-24 kuNovemba.

48519b6d09e314758073.headline: Abasebenzi baseTFG batekwile ezikhungweni ezimbili eGauteng bafuna ukunyuselwa ngama-94%
48519b6d09e314758073.dek: Amakhulu abasebenzi avale izitolo ezikhungweni zokusabalalisa zaseKempton Park naseMidrand emva kokuba ukuxoxisana ngamaholo kuphazamisekile.
48519b6d09e314758073.why: Abasebenzi baseTFG bafuna imali yezamahora engeziwe ngempelaviki, abathi abayitholi njengamanje.
paragraphs: Amakhulu abasebenzi baseThe Foschini Group (TFG) ezikhungweni zokusabalalisa eKempton Park naseMidrand, eGauteng, batekwile ngoMsombuluko, mhla ziyi-23 kuNovemba, befuna ukunyuselwa amaholo okungenani ngama-94%. Bafake isaziso samahora angu-48 ngoLwesine, mhla zingama-20 kuNovemba emva kokuthi ukuxoxisana kuvalekile.

U-Esther Mwasi, umsebenzi nommeli weSimunye Workers Forum, uthe abasebenzi baqoqene ezikhungweni kusukela ekuseni ngoMsombuluko. Ulinganisele ukuthi ababengaphezulu kwabayi-100 abebekhona, yize umnyango uthi abasebenzi bangaba yi-295. I-TFG ithe icele iCCMA ukuthi isize ezingxoxweni, kodwa abasebenzi benqabile, nokho inkampani isavulekile ukuthi kuxoxwe.

Leli fowamu liphinde lifune isikhathi sokusebenza kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya uLwesihlanu, amahora angu-45 ngesonto, imali yezamahora engeziwe ngempelaviki kanye namaholo acacile esikhundleni ngasinye. Litshela ukuthi abanye abasebenzi bahola kancane njengo-R6 200 ngenyanga.
